snippet.title: Season 01 Zombies Trailer | Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies
snippet.description:
The undead just went interstellar 🪐 

Follow the footsteps of the forgotten and hunt down the Shadowsmith in the new Season 01 Zombies map “Astra Malorum” coming on December 4 🧟
